description: This file defines a 'NoteEditor' component for a note-taking application using the LightningJS framework. It includes UI templates, state management, input handling, and event logic related to editing, saving, canceling, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: A LightningJS component for editing notes, with properties for note data and event callbacks.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes the component's reactive state based on props, including UI themes, editing state, and precomputed styles.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Watches for changes in 'note' and 'editing' properties to update local state accordingly.

methods.name: input.char
methods.description: Handles character input when editing a note, appending characters to the content.

methods.name: input.backspace
methods.description: Handles backspace input, removing the last character from content.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles the Enter key, toggling editing mode.

methods.name: input.ctrl_s
methods.description: Handles the save shortcut (Ctrl+S or Cmd+S), invokes 'onSave' callback with current title and content.

methods.name: events.click.handler
methods.description: Handles click events on various buttons in the UI, triggering editing, saving, canceling, or deleting notes based on click position.
